target.value_rule: strictly positive finite author-reported value; blanks, explicit zero and NA are excluded without imputation
target.rank_rule: descending midrank percentile computed independently within each source measurement batch using all eligible source rows
target.identity_feature_policy: protein identity, source identity, laboratory identity, sample labels, author abundance and author rank are prohibited predictive features

target_freeze.selection_rule: the five-target panel is frozen before T273 model execution and is not recomputed within any outer fold; results are conditional on this fixed panel
target_freeze.held_out_target_membership_contribution: not used during T273 model fitting or alpha selection; panel provenance remains conditional on the pre-audited three-map intersection

nested_selection.method: deterministic five-fold grouped cross-validation by source-local biological_unit_id within non-held-out laboratories
nested_selection.selection_metric: equal mean across biological units of within-unit mean measurement-batch Spearman correlation

primary_estimand.within_unit_rule: mean of qualified measurement-batch metrics within each biological unit
primary_estimand.population_rule: equal mean over biological units within each held-out laboratory fold

uncertainty.method: bootstrap biological units after within-unit mean across qualified batches

negative_control.method: within-development-measurement-batch target permutation; re-run biological-unit-grouped alpha selection for every permutation; evaluate the held-out fold at the primary biological-unit estimand

coverage_missingness.missingness_model: descriptive exclusion accounting only; no MCAR/MAR/MNAR assumption

claim_boundary: T273 is an author-run analysis-only reanalysis of public paper-attached source maps. It makes biological-unit grouping primary for nested selection, uncertainty, negative control and paired ablation, while remaining conditional on the pre-audited five-target panel. It is not an independent evaluator receipt, no-author reproduction, protected lockbox, clinical validation, community adoption, DOI read-back or scientific submission readiness evidence.
